name: Pride
source:
Cassidy Attaway, a well-known paranormal investigator, is coming back home to take a break before yet another journey. Despite her prominent presence in social media, not many know about the darker side of her story, involving a destructive cult and a sister that the family never mentions. On her way home, Cassidy tries to make a birthday call to her - a call that, she knows, won't go well.

[From [url=https://naarel.itch.io/pride]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Cassidy Attaway是一位知名的超自然现象调查员。她准备回家休息一阵，然后再次踏上旅程。尽管她在社交媒体上颇有名气，却鲜少有人知道她故事中阴暗的一面：一个具有毁灭性的邪教，以及一个家人从不提起的姐妹。回家途中，Cassidy试着打电话祝她生日快乐——她心里清楚，这通电话不会顺利。

[来源：[url=https://naarel.itch.io/pride]Itch.io[/url]]
